Name: Hippo's Cliffside Falls Farm Cave
Author: acearohippo
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Overview: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
Someone in the comment section of my other Farm Cave mod mentioned a farm cave that matches my Cliffside Falls farm map and, yeah, sure why not. I'm recovering from surgery and needed something to occupy my mind during mandatory bed rest. This took me a few hours to do. Guess my Tiled skills are much improved.[/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Update: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
Added a fence to the right side of the map to clearly indicate a boundary. Will show up for all configs.
Made it "compatible" with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10321]Plant Fruit Tress Anywhere (with Dirt)[/url] by CopperSun. Despite the name, the fruit trees can be planted on Grass only. The overlay option for dirt doesn't seem to offer much but an aesthetic look. Not quite sure why, but you can't plant crops in caves anyway, so it doesn't really matter if it works or not.
Also changed it so that Casks can work in the Farm Cave, without needing an extra mod.[/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Features: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
It's a farm cave map replacement. In the same vein as the Variety one, but way smaller and more themed.
[u]Config Options[/u]: Recommend you use Generic Mod Config Menu to make choosing options easier. Otherwise, in order to enable options, you're going to have to [i]type in[/i] each config, manually. Or, you can use one of the exampleconfigs to get you started, just remember to rename them to just "config.json".
See preview pics for visuals of each config.
[list]
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Bench[/color][/u]: Adds a bench and a picnic table near the water.
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Dirt[/color][/u]: Replace the Grass under the mushrooms with dirt.
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Flowers[/color][/u]: Adds flowers in DaisyNiko's style, in pretty patterns.
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Lights[/color][/u]: Places two street lamps where the farm cave entrance is.
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]MushroomFence[/color][/u]: Places picket fences around the area where mushroom boxes go.
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Paved[/color][/u]: Covers grass area under the mushroom spot with paved cement, like in Town. This also covers the Dirt option.
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]SafetyFence[/color][/u]: Gotta have a Safety Fence for those steep cliffs... Or, at the very least, one side of it.
[/list][/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Requirements: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
[list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets
[/list][/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Install/Uninstall: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left] Extract zipped files and place them in the Mods folder.[/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Mods I Recommend: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]Map recolours, foliage retextures, and/or reshades to make this map POP. Would, sadly, not recommend Vamoosi's Rosier Coloured Glasses or DustBeauty's Stardew Valley Foliage- Original/Reshade recolours as DaisyNiko has not made compatibility for the former (yet) and is unable to colour correct for the latter two, as SFR has been removed for downloads.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10379]Cliffside Falls Farm[/url] by acearohippo, aka me. Matched the aesthetics of this farm edit, down to the config options :D
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10296]Craftable Mushroom Box[/url] by foggywizard. Allows you to move Mushroom Boxes, as long as the mod is installed before Mushroom cave is chosen. Then, you can craft more after you make enough money and befriend Demetrius. Content pack for [color=#b6d7a8]Content Patcher[/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6194]Craftable Mushroom Box- PFM[/url] by BlatantDecoy. Adds Mushroom Boxes to craftable recipes, unlocked with high enough foraging skill. Content pack for [color=#b6d7a8]Producer Framework Mod[/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10018]Better FarmCave Forage[/url] by acearohippo, that's me. Increases the spawn of all fruits, including DGA/JA added fruits of popular mods. Content pack for [color=#b6d7a8]Farm Type Manager[/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10186]Farm Cave Spawns More Tree Fruit[/url] by atravita. A highly configurable mod that allows you to control many aspects of fruit tree spawns in caves. A Smapi mod (doesn't need another framework to work)[/left][/size]
